items.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers. [...]

items.title: New Boston Scientific data breach exposes personal, medical info
items.summary: Medical technology company Boston Scientific is sending data breach notices to individuals affected by a cyberattack on the firm. [...]

items.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
items.summary: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. [...]

items.title: Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks
items.summary: The Drupal security team says attackers are exploiting a second critical vulnerability that lets them breach and hijack unpatched websites. [...]

items.title: SAP confirms security incident after suspicious GitHub activity
items.summary: SAP has confirmed to BleepingComputer that it took urgent action to protect its customers after detecting suspicious activity in its IT environment. [...]

items.title: 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach
items.summary: Hackers breached the digital identification and document storage application myColorado and accessed user-uploaded data. The post 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: New NFS2ROOT Linux flaw can let attackers gain root privileges
items.summary: ​A 12-year-old critical vulnerability in the Linux kernel's Network File System (NFS) server, tracked as CVE-2026-99362, allows remote attackers to gain root privileges. [...]

items.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
items.summary: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged. The post Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
items.summary: SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code. The post SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: pCloud confirms password manager hack after suspicious login alerts
items.summary: The pCloud Pass password manager suffered a cyberattack, with users reporting that unknown devices had connected to their accounts even with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled. [...]

items.title: Your Firewall Isn't Enough: The Hidden Risk of Unmanaged VMs
items.summary: Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive access permissions can create security blind spots across IT infrastructure. ISPsystem explains how centralized infrastructure management, access controls, and resource lifecycle automation can help reduce these risks. [...]

items.title: Microsoft removes WSUS server role in Windows Server 2028
items.summary: Microsoft will remove the WSUS server role from Windows Server 2028, the next major release of its server operating system. [...]

items.title: Microsoft pushes emergency hotpatch to fix Windows Server crashes
items.summary: Microsoft has released an emergency hotpatch update to address Windows Server 2025 crashes triggered after installing this month's security hotpatch update (KB5131077). [...]

items.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
items.summary: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign. The post Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
items.summary: FIFA didn’t say when the cyberattack took place, or the precise nature of the hacked information. The post FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-103406, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root. The post Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code
items.summary: A hacker used a compromised employee GitHub account to push malicious code and steal customer records, but vaults were not accessed. The post 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: OpenAI warns GPT-6.2 Astra will hit usage limits 40% faster because it fixed a bug
items.summary: OpenAI confirmed that it fixed a 'bug' that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 usage, which means you'll now hit GPT usage limits 40% faster than before. [...]

items.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
items.summary: An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars. [...]

items.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
items.summary: The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service. [...]

items.title: Se l’intelligenza artificiale scrive le nostre cartelle cliniche
items.summary: Gli scriba basati su AI promettono di liberare i medici dalle carte, ma possono omettere informazioni importanti, alterare il contenuto delle visite e introdurre errori nelle cartelle cliniche. Spesso è il paziente ad accorgersene per primo.

items.title: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
items.summary: Drupal warns that its previous installer patch left some websites vulnerable to takeover, with attackers already exploiting the gap. The post Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
items.summary: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE. The post Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
